name: Edit request with existing image

images.label: sunset_beach
images.generationContext: A warm sunset over a sandy beach with gentle waves

successCriteria: The orchestrator should dispatch an image-to-image task (not text-to-image) since this is an edit of an existing image. The dispatch should reference [image:img-001] as the source image. It should view the image before dispatching. The brief should specify what to change (darker sky) and what to preserve (the rest of the scene).
